about_the_game:
Explore the multiverse with different versions of NUSNURs where every universe has its own mechanics, style, story, and lore. Observe how their lives connect and how everything ends.

START THE ADVENTURE WITH NIMBUS

Meet the cast of the universe of Nimbus Seynasirun, whose search for happiness turns into obsession of ignorance.

Follow her adventure and acknowledge her ideals while exploring personalities of other cast members. Observe multiple outcomes and discover different conclusions. I will be with you throughout...

HACK AND SLASH WITH EYE MAGIC

In a universe where your eye color decides who you are and grants you the power that can bring chaos or peace... Their eyes are pure, they are not like you.

TURN BASED STRATEGY AND BULLET HELL

Every universe has its own twist, its own mechanics. In the universe of eyes, try to understand illusion battles.

Observe how they utilize their magic and how it affects their lives as they try to reach their goals.

CO-OP WITH YOUR FRIENDS

Get ready for an adventure with your friends across the universes of NUSNUR.

Emote all over the story for some goofy time.

Team up and observe Nimbus and her illusions as they take down anything that stands in their way.

Why not settle who among you would have been the greatest eye magic warrior of all time... in a bit of "friendly" imagination battle?

MYSTERY OF ALL

Let us embark on this journey, and find out how everything ends...

- Soul Waiter
